abort_if: /health english revision differs from the preregistered one at any check
comparison: per-assessment agreement of the thresholded decision and |dP| vs the local (convaiinnovations/laya 55cf4c4e) run on identical state text

criteria.expected: Observed evidence is consistent with expected operation
criteria.fault_consistent: Observed evidence supports an abnormal/fault-consistent condition
criteria.insufficient: Available evidence cannot distinguish expected from abnormal

condition.instructions: Which condition best fits the provided current and prior window evidence?

criteria.insufficient: Missing, unsupported, or conflicting evidence prevents an assessment
criteria.sufficient: Enough relevant evidence to make an assessment

evidence.instructions: Is the provided physical and numerical evidence sufficient to assess this window? Choose insufficient if key evidence is missing or conflicting.

criteria.no_review: Evidence does not warrant operator review
criteria.uncertain: Cannot determine whether review is warranted

review.instructions: Should this candidate window receive operator review based only on the evidence shown?

rule.elevate: review.choice == 'review' AND P(review) >= 0.80 AND TypeSafe Choice confidence (p_max-1/n)/(1-1/n) of the review probabilities >= 0.50
rule.laya_confidence_fields: Laya `confidence` and `answer_confidence` are recorded descriptively and never used for decisions
rule.schedule: assess on candidate entry, then at most once per observed hour while decision_state stays in {unresolved, alarm}; clean in-reference windows are never assessed (they appear only as previous-window context)
rule.unavailable: exception/invalid/truncated answer => explicit unavailable; never elevates and never suppresses a baseline alarm
